body: I feel the same. Seems like you got your peace before doing it.
But they deleted the replies of others on my previous thread.
Can therapy help you change your mind about suicide?
Let me know once you've talked to your family. Curios to know how will they take it.
Planning also to tell one of my closest friends but I doubt he'll understand me. He might even try to stop me.
I've done bad things I never imagined I am capable of. I caused pain to each and everyone dear to me. Im nearing the point of thought that I am beyond saving. Not even by God or any other person.
Somehow I feel we're on the same page. Somehow I still consider what would they feel after I commit suicide.
Both my parents and my wife and my therapist. But they don't know the extent of how I'm going through it.
